status: Scratch investigation; no new production source or local package promoted.
work_mode: Main thread only. No subagents used or reactivated.
scope: Actual exported Linux Forward+ 2560x1440 sky and enhanced-water fallback, identical game-clock interval for original/prototype/prototype/original arms.

Four weather-field variants replace only the six horizontal weather/type noise samples. Vertical profile, 3D shape/erosion, ray steps and scattering remain live. Exact original fallback beyond the bounded domain.

Shape weather varies every rendered frame. Held phase state avoids dispatch. GPU writes use the main RenderingDevice, no CPU texture readback in construction/update; images are read only for validation.
Phase-hoist experiment moves ray-invariant scattering terms out of the march without a new cache, pass or reduced quadrature.
Resolution probe keeps High 192 primary/5 light steps but changes its sky subpass from half to quarter resolution. This is a quality/performance tradeoff, not exact equivalence.

variants.cloud-weather15: 1024 square, linear mapping over +/-65536 m, RGBA16F, 8 MiB, separate render thread; no compute GPU markers yet.
variants.cloud-weather16: 2048 square, linear mapping over +/-65536 m, RGBA16F, 32 MiB; separate compute GPU timestamps, safe render thread.
variants.cloud-weather17: 2048 square over +/-16384 m, RGBA16F, 32 MiB. Finer nearby field with exact original outside; most savings lost.
variants.cloud-weather18: 2048 square, separable quadratic mapping over +/-65536 m, RGBA16_UNORM, 32 MiB. Signed square-root inverse lookup; greater precision at nearby coordinates. Both variants preheated 2.5 seconds before each quality ABBA.
variants.cloud-phase19: Explicitly hoist the three ray/light-angle phase terms; no cache. Original operations retained. Both source variants preheated.
variants.cloud-resolution20: High quarter-resolution probe; Low byte-identical source control. Both source variants preheated.

limitations: All six runs overlap foreign Godot render processes at recorded endpoints; descriptive paired results only, not clean-device or Windows speedups.
Windows RTX4090 Mobile/D3D12 execution was unavailable. These runs do not reproduce or resolve the reported Windows 9 FPS case.

Strict held-sky checks fail on some unchanged High arms as well as some candidates. Later fixtures preserve every control delta and failed capture. No threshold was relaxed or failure removed; the cause of one-level changes remains unproven.
Viewport GPU timestamps exclude the separate weather compute dispatch. Rows16-18 record that dispatch separately; Vulkan engine source confirms nanoseconds, converted to ms by /1e6.
Run15 separate-thread per-yield wall times are CPU waits, not complete frame cost. Runs16+ also record entire loop elapsed/drawn-frame count; selected later runs use safe thread mode.
Image deltas were measured, not asserted as a quality-acceptance pass. No Mobile/Compatibility, seasonal sweep, field-boundary or production owner/lifetime qualification exists for these prototypes.
No production cache/controller/resources/default/setting changed. Existing unrelated V1 scratch modifications remain untouched.
decision: Do not ship the 8/32 MiB weather caches or phase hoist from these results. Preserve source and evidence; evaluate resolution quality separately before any implementation.
